```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 5.5
)
```

```{r setup}
library(golfops)
fences <- peoria_rate_fences()
card <- peoria_rate_card()
products <- unique(card[, c("facility", "product", "holes")])

lookup <- function(segment, day, daypart) {
  rows <- card[card$segment == segment & card$day == day & card$daypart == daypart, ]
  key <- paste(products$facility, products$product)
  rows$price[match(key, paste(rows$facility, rows$product))]
}

show_prices <- function(frame, price_cols) {
  for (col in price_cols) {
    frame[[col]] <- ifelse(is.na(frame[[col]]), "N/A", sprintf("%.2f", frame[[col]]))
  }
  frame
}
```

These are the posted prices on the Peoria weekday and weekend sheet, version 2. Ten products are on the sheet. Kellogg, Madison, and Newman each post an 18-hole course, a front nine, and a back nine. Kellogg also posts Executive, a nine-hole course. The course key on the sheet spells Newman as Neuman. The tables below use Newman.

A blank cell is a fence the sheet leaves empty. The sheet has no count of rounds, so it has no revenue. Quantity from the earlier fictional card is gone.

## Segments

```{r fences, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
shown_fences <- fences
shown_fences$posted <- ifelse(shown_fences$posted, "Posted", "Blank")
knitr::kable(
  shown_fences,
  col.names = c("Segment", "What is priced", "Rule", "On the sheet"),
  caption = "Fences on the Peoria sheet. Twilight is a daypart on the adult green fee. Blank means every cell in that column is empty."
)
```

## Weekday

Adult, senior, and junior are walking green fees. Twilight is the adult twilight green fee. Adult with cart is the posted price for an adult round that includes a cart. On a weekday that price equals the adult green fee plus the cart fee, on every product.

```{r weekday, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
weekday <- data.frame(
  Facility = products$facility,
  Product = products$product,
  Holes = products$holes,
  Adult = lookup("Adult", "Weekday", "Day"),
  Twilight = lookup("Adult", "Weekday", "Twilight"),
  Senior = lookup("Senior", "Weekday", "Day"),
  Junior = lookup("Junior", "Weekday", "Day"),
  `Adult with cart` = lookup("Adult with cart", "Weekday", "Day"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(
  show_prices(weekday, c("Adult", "Twilight", "Senior", "Junior", "Adult with cart")),
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Weekday posted prices, in dollars. N/A is an empty cell on the sheet."
)
```

Twilight is posted on Kellogg Executive, Kellogg Back 9, and Madison Back 9. On Kellogg Executive the twilight green fee is $30.00 and the day rate is $24.00. On Madison Back 9 the twilight green fee is $27.00 and the day rate is $20.00. On Kellogg Back 9 twilight is $20.00 and the day rate is $30.00.

## Weekend

The walking green fees match the weekday green fees on this sheet. The adult-with-cart column does not. It is a separate posted price.

```{r weekend, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
weekend <- data.frame(
  Facility = products$facility,
  Product = products$product,
  Holes = products$holes,
  Adult = lookup("Adult", "Weekend", "Day"),
  Twilight = lookup("Adult", "Weekend", "Twilight"),
  Senior = lookup("Senior", "Weekend", "Day"),
  Junior = lookup("Junior", "Weekend", "Day"),
  `Adult with cart` = lookup("Adult with cart", "Weekend", "Day"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(
  show_prices(weekend, c("Adult", "Twilight", "Senior", "Junior", "Adult with cart")),
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Weekend posted prices, in dollars. N/A is an empty cell on the sheet."
)
```

## Carts and clubs

The cart fee follows the number of holes: $17.00 on an 18-hole course and $12.00 on a nine-hole product. The pull cart is $5.00 and a single club is $1.00, on every product. The club-rental fee is $20.00 at Kellogg 18 and Newman 18, and $10.00 on the other products, including Madison 18.

```{r extras, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
extras <- data.frame(
  Facility = products$facility,
  Product = products$product,
  Holes = products$holes,
  Cart = lookup("Cart", "Any", "Any"),
  `Pull cart` = lookup("Pull cart", "Any", "Any"),
  `Club per club` = lookup("Club per club", "Any", "Any"),
  `Club rental` = lookup("Club rental", "Any", "Any"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(
  show_prices(extras, c("Cart", "Pull cart", "Club per club", "Club rental")),
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Cart and club fees, in dollars. The sheet does not split these by weekday or weekend."
)
```

The card has `r nrow(card)` posted prices. Junior twilight, military, and the holiday 18-hole rate with a cart are columns on the sheet with no prices in them. The holiday header names May 11 through September 29.

A played round can still add fences. An adult weekday round with a cart is already one posted price. A senior round with a cart is the senior green fee plus the cart fee, and that sum is not its own row. The mix of rounds across these fences needs a season of rounds labeled with the product, the day, and the daypart. This sheet does not have that season.
